artworks.title: Statue of a Nude before a Window View
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows intersecting and overlapping lines creating an abstract representation. In the center, a figure stands upright on a rectangular pedestal, resembling a classical statue. To the right, an outline suggests an architectural dome. Below the figure, rounded forms and lines imply smaller, seated figures, resembling an audience or gathering.

artworks.title: Two Statues of Male Nudes
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 14.9 x 10 cm (5 7/8 x 3 15/16 in.)
support: 21.5 x 15.6 cm (8 7/16 x 6 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-length figures of nude individuals. One figure on the left is standing in a relaxed pose with one arm slightly raised, the other resting by its side, and one leg slightly bent. This figure appears to be leaning against an abstract form resembling a tree trunk or pillar. The other figure on the right has one arm raised above the head and the other bending outward at the elbow. Both figures have facial features with soft lines for the nose and mouth, and indicated hair styles. The focus is on the outline and musculature of the human form. The background is plain without additional elements.

artworks.title: Statue of Zeus Holding a Thunderbolt
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The sketch depicts a standing person with a slightly forward-leaning posture and one arm extended outward. The figure has long hair flowing past the shoulders, possible facial hair, and is wearing loose, classical robes that cover one shoulder and extend down to the feet. There are no visible jewelry or items being held, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Interior of a Roman Palace
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior architectural scene. The drawing depicts a grand, arched interior space. The viewer's eye is led into the space by a series of columns and arches. The drawing uses light and shadow to emphasize the architectural elements such as the columns and the arches. To the right, a niche houses a statue. The perspective and shading techniques provide a sense of scale and craftsmanship, capturing the grandeur of the architecture.

artworks.title: Statue of Cleopatra
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a person in a reclining position. The person is lying on their side, with one arm raised above their head and the other arm resting beside their body. The facial features are minimally detailed, and the hair is draped around the head and shoulders. The person is shown with cloth covering parts of the lower body and the upper torso more exposed. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain, and the sketch is set against a simple, lightly textured surface.

artworks.title: Group of Male Figures Conversing
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 12.4 x 10.1 cm (4 7/8 x 4 in.)
support: 21.5 x 15.6 cm (8 7/16 x 6 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in motion. The sketch features multiple figures, drawn with quick and loose lines. Some of the figures appear to be holding swords. The style of the drawing conveys a sense of dynamic movement and energy, with emphasis on flowing drapery and expressive postures. The use of charcoal or pencil adds depth with varying shades and textures.

artworks.title: S. Rocco
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a sketch of architectural structures from a frontal perspective, showcasing symmetry. The horizon is indistinct, with an emphasis on a slope leading to the buildings. A large dome stands out at the center of the complex of structures extending across the scene. The sketch features loose, fluid pencil strokes indicating form and shadow rather than explicit details, which creates depth and texture. The color scheme is monochromatic, with varying shades of gray from the pencil on a simple background. Steps in the foreground lead upwards, while architectural details in the distance, such as a smaller dome and vertical lines, add depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Italian City Scene
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This pencil sketch depicts a scene of rustic architecture from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is at the top of the drawing, with trees and simple structures in the foreground. Two large building-like forms are prominent, one on the left and one on the right. Lines suggest smaller structures or a courtyard area between them. The monochromatic palette uses varying shades of graphite for depth. The pencil strokes are light and confident, detailing the forms and shading subtly to capture mass and space.

artworks.title: Seated Male Nude with Arm over Head, Seen from the Side
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 9.2 x 7.9 cm (3 5/8 x 3 1/8 in.)
support: 15.6 x 21.5 cm (6 1/8 x 8 7/16 in.)

artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a seated figure with a bent posture, indistinct facial features, dark wavy hair, and no clothing. The background is minimal with shading behind the figure.

artworks.title: Young Woman's Head in Profile
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The sketch depicts a profile view of a person's upper body, from the chest upwards. The individual is facing sideways to the left. Their facial features are delicately outlined, with a prominent nose and a subtle smile. The eyes are minimally detailed, and the hair is styled elaborately with decorative elements resembling ribbons or bows. Simple lines suggest clothing, possibly a collar or upper garment. The background is plain and unadorned, directing focus to the drawing's subject.

artworks.title: Little Girl with a Large Basket
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a person holding a large basket. The person is slightly hunched forward. The facial features are minimally detailed, with a general outline of the face, eyes, and a mouth. The person's hair seems to be pulled back or covered by a bonnet or hat. The clothing includes a long-sleeved top and a long skirt or apron. The sketch is set on a plain background.

artworks.title: Statue of a Vestal Virgin

artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person in a standing position with one hand on their hip and the other arm extended. They have a headdress or veil on their head. They are wearing a long flowing garment, possibly a robe. They are next to a pedestal with horizontal lines on its surface. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Villa Medici
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed pencil sketch of architectural structures. The perspective is frontal, showing a series of buildings with a horizon line. The sketch is done in light pencil lines on lightly toned paper. The composition is monochrome, with variations in the pencil markings. The drawing features arches, columns, and distant building elements. The paper shows slight aging marks.

artworks.title: View from a Ridge to a Village and Distant Mountain
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 12.2 x 13.4 cm (4 13/16 x 5 1/4 in.)
support: 15.6 x 21.5 cm (6 1/8 x 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a circular pencil sketch depicting a pastoral scene from a slightly elevated viewpoint. In the drawing, there are architectural structures to the left, with a bridge crossing over a river or stream. In the distance, there are outlines of mountains or hilly terrain. A tree with expressive lines is located on the right side. In the foreground, there is a figure standing, possibly with farming tools or a cart. The drawing is monochromatic, using various shades of grey to create depth. The style of the sketch is loose and sketchy, giving a sense of dynamism and spontaneity.

Overall: 11.2 x 10.1 cm (4 7/16 x 4 in.)
support: 15.6 x 21.5 cm (6 1/8 x 8 7/16 in.)

artworks.description: The image shows a staircase leading up to an architectural structure. On the left, there is a statue on a raised platform. The horizon blends with the sky with no distinct line. The depiction is sketch-like, with visible pencil marks and light brushstrokes on a cream paper. In the distance, there are vague outlines of more architectural features and possible tree forms.

artworks.title: The Obelisk in Saint Peter's Square
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts an obelisk in center surrounded by structures reminiscent of classical architecture, including columns and a domed roof. There are rough outlines of pathways or structures. Two figures are sketched at the top, and there are softly rendered lines in the horizon, possibly representing distant rooftops or trees. The sketch is done with delicate pencil strokes on off-white paper, creating a monochromatic palette.

artworks.title: Capitoline Hill

Overall (approximate): 11.1 x 11.2 cm (4 3/8 x 4 7/16 in.)
support: 15.6 x 21.5 cm (6 1/8 x 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a bridge or elevated walkway leading to a scene with classical architecture and sculptures. The view is of structures and statues rising against the horizon. The sketch features fine pencil lines detailing the architecture, statues, and arches. The color palette is grayscale. A balustrade leads the eye into the composition, while distant structures are faintly sketched, suggesting a historical cityscape.

artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two figures and a horse. On the right is a standing man with crossed arms, bearded, and wearing long garments with a cloak over his shoulder. On the left, another figure is interacting with a rearing horse. The horse is on its hind legs. The background is plain with no other elements.

support: 15.6 x 21.5 cm (6 1/8 x 8 7/16 in.)

artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand architectural interior. It features large arches, columns, and a classical statue in an open space. In the foreground, there is a ladder and some indistinct shapes. The sketch emphasizes structure and form with minimal details, suggesting a Renaissance or neoclassical influence.

artworks.title: Housetops behind a Wall
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene from an elevated viewpoint looking towards the horizon. Architectural elements, including buildings with arched openings and pitched roofs, are sketched with delicate pencil strokes. In the foreground, there are additional structures and figures outlined with smooth pencil marks. The drawing is monochromatic, using shades of gray to emphasize form and line. Faint outlines of buildings in the distance give depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Lady Hamilton Playing a Lyre
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure holding a stringed instrument. The person is depicted from head to just below the knees, positioned to the left and with a slightly hunched upper body. The head is turned to the side, with the gaze downwards. The figure has soft facial features and curly hair tied back. They wear a draped garment and hold the instrument close to their chest with both hands. The background features broad brushstrokes in varying shades of brown.

artworks.title: Man Playing a Lute [recto]
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body sketch of a standing person holding a musical instrument. The person has one leg slightly forward, with one hand on the neck of the instrument and the other on the body. The person's face is slightly tilted with short hair or a head covering. They are wearing clothing with voluminous sleeves and pants, with ties or bands around the knees. The sketch is on aged paper with a blank background.

artworks.title: Man Leaning on a Rail [verso]
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person with their legs and feet fading into undeveloped lines. The person is in a partially turned position to the right with one arm extended. The facial features are roughly sketched, suggesting a profile view. The person appears to be wearing a hat with a brim, and their hair looks curly or wavy. The clothing consists of loose-fitting historical European fashion, including puffy sleeves, a high collar, a doublet with button details, and voluminous trousers or breeches. The sketch is done in red chalk on textured paper, with no background elements.

artworks.title: Battle of Nude Men
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk on four irregularly cut pieces of two types of buff laid paper; laid down and with corner pieces added
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: Drawn with brown ink and black chalk on buff-colored paper, the whole bodies or parts of bodies of at least eleven muscular, nude men fight across this horizontally oriented sheet. In a vignette to the left, one man lifts a club high overhead as two men cower at his feet. Next to that, a man slices the head from a prone victim. Next, a man holds hands overhead as he pins another prone man on the ground with a foot to the neck. Others struggle to get up, lie injured, or swing weapons. One disembodied head is at the top center of the composition, and a pile of armor with a shield, a bow, quiver and arrows, and a sword are near the lower right corner. The four corners of the paper appear to have been cut and then the bits of paper replaced next to the main sheets.
